SUNY LEGAL

Cookie Policy

Information for visitors to the SUNY website.

Last updated: September 18, 2026

1. Current use

This website currently uses only essential browser storage needed for basic site preferences and user experience. We do not currently use advertising cookies or behavioral advertising trackers.

2. Browser storage

When you dismiss the website privacy notice, your browser may store a small preference value so that the notice does not appear repeatedly. This information is stored locally in your browser.

3. Third-party content

Some website assets, such as images, may be delivered through our cloud hosting or content delivery infrastructure. Those providers may receive standard technical request information such as IP address, browser type and request time as part of normal internet delivery.

4. Future changes

If we later introduce analytics, advertising or other non-essential tracking technologies, this policy and the consent mechanism should be updated before those technologies are enabled where consent is required.

5. Managing storage

You can clear cookies and local browser storage through your browser settings. Doing so may cause notices or preferences to appear again.

SUNY 法律信息

Cookie 政策

适用于三立电子官方网站访问者的相关说明。

最后更新：2026 年 9 月 18 日

1. 当前使用情况

本网站目前仅使用维持基本网站功能和用户偏好所必需的浏览器存储。我们目前不使用广告 Cookie，也不使用行为广告追踪技术。

2. 浏览器存储

当您关闭网站隐私提示后，浏览器可能会在本地保存一个小型偏好值，以避免该提示反复出现。该信息保存在您的浏览器中。

3. 第三方内容

网站中的部分资源（例如图片）可能通过我们的云存储或内容分发基础设施提供。作为正常互联网访问的一部分，相关服务提供商可能接收 IP 地址、浏览器类型、请求时间等标准技术请求信息。

4. 未来调整

如果未来增加网站分析、广告或其他非必要追踪技术，我们将在需要用户同意的情况下，在启用前同步更新本政策及相应的同意机制。

5. 管理方式

您可以通过浏览器设置清除 Cookie 和本地浏览器存储。清除后，相关提示或偏好设置可能再次出现。
